_comment: The watch list. THIS IS THE ONLY FILE TO EDIT — add {"title": "..."} and run
which resolves the rest from Wikidata: the IMDb id, the year, the genres, and
a title logo from Wikimedia Commons when a freely-licensed one exists.
`qid` pins a Wikidata item by hand. Use it when a title is ambiguous -- 'The
`imdb` pins the id by hand; `no_imdb` says there is no good match and stops the
script guessing. Tom and Jerry has one because the search finds a folk-rock duo.
Boys' resolves to a 1962 series without one. `bg`/`fg` paint the fallback
card for titles with no free logo, which is most of them.
`rank` marks the ranked favourites (1, 2, 3); `anime = true` marks anime.
Anything else is just on the list.
`tmdb_id` pins the poster when /find picks the wrong entry or has none —
The Chosen had a 2009 namesake, Tom and Jerry has no id to /find on at all.
`movies` is the same shape and goes through the same script. Films almost
always get a TMDb poster, so bg/fg here are only the fallback nobody sees.
